topic: Phone camera sees through black plastic
hook: Your phone camera can see through some black plastic.
title: Your Camera Sees Through Black Plastic
description:
Cover an old-style filament bulb with a thin black plastic bag and film it. Near-infrared light passes through the plastic and your camera picks it up, so the bulb shows on screen. It works better on some phones than others, and the plastic must be thin.

#Shorts #PhoneTricks #Tech
comment_prompt: Did it work on your phone? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your phone camera can see through some black plastic.
scenes.headline: Camera Sees Through

scenes.narration: Switch on an old filament bulb.
scenes.headline: Switch On A Bulb

scenes.narration: Cover it with a thin black plastic bag.
scenes.headline: Cover It Up

scenes.narration: To your eyes, the bulb nearly disappears.
scenes.headline: Eyes See Nothing

scenes.narration: Now film it with your phone camera.
scenes.headline: Now Film It

scenes.narration: The bulb shows up right through the bag.
scenes.headline: Bulb Shows Up

scenes.narration: Near-infrared light passes through the plastic.
scenes.headline: Near-Infrared Light

scenes.narration: You can't see it, but your camera can.
scenes.headline: Invisible To Eyes

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: another place that shouldn't exist.
scenes.headline: Up Next
